subject: Highlighting unused portion of a plot

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Highlighting unused portion of a plot
parts:
Hi all,

Please consider the following plot :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat <- zooreg(rnorm(100), start = as.yearmon("2004-01-01"), frequency
= 12); head(dat)
ggplot() + geom_line(aes(y=coredata(dat), x=as.numeric(index(dat))),
colour="blue")


In the plot, there are some un-used space at all 4 edges on that,
means graph does not actually start from the left edge of the plot
niether ends at the right edge of the same. Here I want to put a
different color for this unused space. If anyone guide me how to
achive this, it would be great.

Thanks,

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Highlighting unused portion of a plot
parts:
Hi,

If I understand correctly, you might want,

1- to reduce the range of the x and y scales to fit the data exactly,

p = ggplot() + geom_line(aes(y=coredata(dat),
x=as.numeric(index(dat))), colour="blue")
p + scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0))

2- or to draw rectangles with annotate,

p + annotate("rect",
xmin=c(-1,1)*Inf,xmax=c(2004,2012),ymin=rep(-Inf,2),ymax=rep(Inf,2),fill="red")

HTH,

baptiste

parts:
Hi there, I cannot draw a rectangle using annotate() function if x-
axis is date variable. Please consider following lines of code :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat1 <- zooreg(rnorm(20), start=as.yearmon(as.Date("2008-01-01")),
frequency=12); dat1
df1 <- data.frame(value=coredata(dat1), dates=index(dat1))
ggplot(df1, aes(x=as.Date(index(dat1)))) + geom_line(aes(x=as.Date
(index(dat1)), y=value)) +
annotate("rect", xmin=c(-Inf), xmax=c(Inf), ymin=c(-Inf), ymax=c(min
(df1$value)-3/100), fill="gray94")

I am getting following error while running it :
Error in seq.int(r1$year, to$year, by) : 'from' must be finite

However it is working fine if I dont use annotate() portion. However
if x-axis is numeric then there is no problem. Can anyone please tell
me how to tackle that?

Thanks,
